purpose: 竹影问剑水墨美术增强，原创游戏运行素材

promptSet.scene: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual real-time game background plate, landscape 16:9 panoramic composition, NOT a game screenshot or UI. Create an exquisite Chinese ink-wash wuxia painting of a misty mountain bamboo grove on fibrous antique ivory xuan paper. Traditional freehand brush art, irregular dry-brush edges, wet ink blooms, delicate rice paper fibers, pools of dense near-black ink against pale translucent grey washes, restrained moss green; one small dusty vermilion sun upper-right and NO lettering. Strong scenic depth: monumental distant cliffs dissolving into negative-space mist; painterly midground bamboo forest; richly authored near bamboo trunks and jagged rocks on far left and far right. Open center for a side-view sword duel, with softly brushed grey rock terrace spanning full width at exactly 72 percent from the top; the top edge of the terrace is horizontal so runtime characters can stand there. Below that line, foreground dry brush stone path and ink textures, subtle irregular horizontal brushwork. Dense tactile painting at edges, luminous open central combat space, asymmetric cinematic scroll composition. Low contrast near the upper 12 percent for HUD; no people, characters, weapon, UI, numbers, labels, grid, frame, watermark. Highly crafted ink landscape, not flat grey polygon mountains or vector shapes.
promptSet.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ACTUAL transparent animation sprite atlas for a side-view Chinese ink-wash sword-fighting game. Create a strict TWO COLUMN by THREE ROW rectangular atlas, six equal square cells, no gaps beyond each cell's internal 12% transparent safe margin, no visible grid, labels, lettering, shadows on ground, background or watermark. In every cell show the SAME full-body wuxia wandering swordsman facing RIGHT, feet aligned at identical bottom baseline 90% within each cell, approximately same head and body scale; sword may use side margins but all strokes stay wholly inside each cell. Painterly Chinese freehand ink illustration: elegant human anatomy, beautiful flowing layered ink-black robe, rough brush hems and cloth folds, broad woven bamboo straw hat obscuring face, a muted vermilion waist sash with cloth tails, bound boots. Soft ink wash shading, expressive dry brush edges and subtle ink feathering, high detail not polygons, block limbs or modern cartoon. Design recognizable at small gameplay size. Six poses in exact row-major order: upper-left IDLE alert low sword angled down-right, upper-right WALK forward right with one boot raised and trailing robe; middle-left ATTACK powerful forward diagonal sword slash, extended sword and billowing robe but no giant effects; middle-right PARRY sword held diagonally upward across chest guarding incoming blade from right; lower-left DODGE low backward left lean with bent knees and hat retained; lower-right HURT recoiling torso with knees flexed, sword lowered. Full hat, robe, boots, hands and blade completely visible inside each cell. Each complete human figure drawn independently, one pose per cell, consistent silhouette design and proportions. True transparent alpha background, do not paint a checkerboard, no ground scene.
promptSet.enemy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ACTUAL transparent opponent animation atlas for Chinese ink-wash sword-fighting game. Strict THREE COLUMN by THREE ROW grid, nine equal square cells, no grid lines, no labels/text/numbers, no watermark, no backdrop, no ground shadows. Every full-body fighter faces RIGHT, feet at 90 percent height of each cell and same approximate 70 percent body height, blades and brush details remain within each cell's transparent 12 percent safe margin. Columns correspond to exact poses: first column IDLE low blade down-right; second column WINDUP sword lifted high over head preparing a descending cut; third column STRIKE dynamic forward diagonal cut with robe flying, blade extended right. Rows correspond to three clearly DIFFERENT opponents, consistent identity across that row: top row lean Chinese swordsman with topknot and moss-grey layered martial robe, tiny rust-red headband; middle row powerful broad-shouldered warrior in heavy weathered dark ink-grey cloak with wrapped sleeves, wide stance and larger straight sword; bottom row mysterious slender assassin wearing deep ink-black pointed hood and long ragged flowing robe with a small vermilion tie. Each is a sophisticated Chinese freehand brush painting: organic realistic human silhouettes and anatomy, expressive cloth, traditional dry-brush strokes, ink wash translucent shading, rough feathered edges, few ivory highlights. Elegant and richly authored, NOT simple geometric shapes, stick men or generic cartoon. The same art direction as antique xuan-paper wuxia paintings. All nine human figures are separate, identical scale and grid alignment. Genuine transparent alpha background. No painted white paper or checkerboard background.

edits.enemy: Edit target: the attached transparent Chinese ink-wash enemy sprite atlas. Preserve all THREE identities, painterly clothing texture, black/grey/vermilion palette and nine intended poses. Change ONLY layout and empty margins to make it an accurately usable game atlas. Rebuild as a perfectly square THREE equal COLUMNS by THREE equal ROWS grid with exactly one full figure per cell. Every complete figure including long blade, head, trailing robe and all boots must be wholly contained in its own cell, with at least 12 percent completely transparent empty margins on ALL FOUR sides. SHRINK each entire figure plus its sword together if needed. No weapon from one cell may cross into another cell. Especially: the overhead swords in middle column must not cross the left cell boundary, and swords in right column must have visible tips plus substantial clear alpha padding to the right edge; bottom hooded characters cannot touch canvas bottom. Feet aligned to 85% height within each cell; roughly same body height across nine. Layout row-major retained: top row topknot swordsman, middle row broad strong warrior, bottom row hooded assassin; each row columns idle/windup/strike. Make grid boundaries mathematically even; no grid lines or cell borders. Genuine fully transparent background, no color wash around actors, no labels, text, shadows, watermark. This is a transparent animation atlas, not illustration on black paper.
edits.hero: Edit target: attached six-pose transparent ink swordsman atlas. Keep the exact same wandering swordsman with woven straw hat, black ink-wash layered robe, red sash, the excellent brush texture, color, human anatomy and SIX poses. Change ONLY each cell's composition, size and clear padding for safe game use. STRICT TWO equal COLUMNS by THREE equal ROWS in a portrait 2:3 canvas, six perfectly square tiles. Shrink/reposition each WHOLE figure INCLUDING THE ENTIRE SWORD so no pixel of hat, robe, hair, sword, sash or boots goes outside its own tile. Full sword tip must be present and inside that tile. In particular the MIDDLE LEFT ATTACK blade currently crosses the middle vertical grid boundary into the PARRY tile: make that attack pose significantly smaller within its cell so the whole blade fits. Provide at least 8 percent fully transparent margins around every complete pose, 12% gap between any artwork and central vertical grid boundary. All boots at approximately 88% cell-height baseline, consistent body scale across frames except crouch/recoil. Row-major: idle / walking; forward attacking / parrying diagonal high sword; dodging low / recoiling hurt. NO giant slash effects, colored haze, ground shadow, grid lines, labels, text, paper, grey/black background, checkerboard or watermark. Actual transparent alpha behind figures. Preserve identities and poses, especially do not replace beautiful brush illustration with simplified cartoon. Exact usable atlas, completely disconnected full figures with substantial transparent spacing.
edits.heroAttack: Create ONE isolated full-body attack sprite of the exact straw-hat swordsman in this reference, same black ink-wash robe, white inner cloth, muted cinnabar-red waist sash, worn boots, illustrated face, SAME traditional Chinese dry-brush and fine ink illustration style. Extract and faithfully reinterpret ONLY the attack pose from the middle-left of the reference: swordsman low in a strong wide lunge, looking and attacking to the RIGHT, sword arm extended to the right at shoulder height. ONE FIGURE ONLY, no atlas, no other poses, no layout grid. Every part of the entire straw hat, cloth, both feet, sword hilt and complete pointed sword blade must be contained well inside this single image with generous fully empty transparent margins on ALL four sides. The full thin sword blade must fit to the right with at least 12% empty margin beyond its point. Foot sole near the bottom at about 84% of image height. REAL clean transparent background. No scene, ground, backdrop gradient, glow, aura, drop shadow, particles, letters, marks or frame. The sprite should be centered horizontally including its complete sword, contained in the middle 76% of canvas. Preserve the same character identity and line texture as the reference; restrained black and ivory with red sash only.
